**Why it's blocked:** T9's contract and its check script (`oracle/T9/check.mjs`) require two things of the "Sort by" control:
- It must sit outside the Books `<section>`.
- It must come after the "Books" heading in the page's underlying order.

The Books section holds both the "Books" heading and the books. Anything outside the section therefore comes either before the heading or after all the books. No spot is after the heading, before the books, and outside the section, so T10 can't pass without changing one of T9's rules and its check script.

**Options I listed:**

I didn't write a contract for T11. I wrote `/work/.bakeoff/BLOCKED.json` (type `BLOCKED:DECISION`) instead, because the intent clashes with work that's already accepted. That file is valid JSON, and no other files in the repo were changed.

**The clash:** Task T6 already shipped an optional list description. It has a "Description" field on the create and edit forms and shows directly below the list name on `/lists/{id}` and `/s/{token}`. Its frozen contract, and the check script that verifies it (`oracle/T6/check.mjs`), require a 500-character limit, with exactly 500 characters accepted. The T11 intent asks for the same feature with a 280-character limit.

Getting to 280 would mean amending the T6 contract and its check. You would also have to decide what happens to stored descriptions of 281–500 characters. Cutting them short would lose data, which would make this a critical-tier task.
